newsitem.title: GREECE: Athens bourse starts trade after technical hitch.
newsitem.headline: Athens bourse starts trade after technical hitch.

text.p: Trading at the Athens bourse started at 1115 gmt after technical problems with the screen-based system prompted authorities to halt the session and cancel early trades.
The abbreviated Tuesday session would end at 1315, officials said. Stocks were drifting lower in thin trade.

"The system seems to be working fine now. Trading volume is low and will likely stay this way today. The 50 basis point cut in the upcoming December one-year T-bill is tremendous news but the market is not ready to react," said a floor trader.
Trading volume was 246 million drachmas after 15 minutes of trade with the general share index bobbing around 908 points. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
